analysis.scope: Fresh labelled synthetic native experiments on two actual CPUs/512MiB; one baseline, two early recovery conditions, second interruption and cancellation. Graceful isolated-app shutdown, not power failure. Complete caller times include restarts; resumed monotonic totals unavailable and excluded from calibration. Independent arithmetic is not a second physics solver. No physical accuracy or LLM-training claim.

limits: Fresh labelled synthetic native experiments on two actual CPUs/512MiB; one baseline, two early recovery conditions, second interruption and cancellation. Graceful isolated-app shutdown, not power failure. Complete caller times include restarts; resumed monotonic totals unavailable and excluded from calibration. Independent arithmetic is not a second physics solver. No physical accuracy or LLM-training claim.
Only two-stage recovered sequences exercised here. Three-stage budgeting is tested arithmetically; three-stage native recovery and abrupt power loss remain unvalidated.
Resumed totalMillis=0 means unavailable; it is excluded from calibration. Caller times include controlled restarts and test observations, so are not pure engine throughput.
